newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA SHARES SET RECORD HIGH FOR SECOND DAY.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA SHARES SET RECORD HIGH FOR SECOND DAY.

text.p: 1413 GMT - South African industrial stocks firm marginally towards close after drifting narrowly mixed on weaker rand. All-share index adds 13.5 points to 7,107.7, a new all time closing high for second day running.

Dealers say underlying sentiment positive. Market players watching Wall St, gold price and currency for direction on Thursday. The industrial index edges 1.1 points up to 8,369.2 and golds jump 32.8 points to 1,481.6.
Anglos drop 1.50 rand to 275 rand, De Beers gain 50 cents to 150.50 rand and Val Reefs leaps nine rand to 340 rand.
